I've replied to Dana in their DM: send Thursday's Tamsin Cold Chain truck to **Bay 47**.

That comes from a note I'd saved earlier. Dana told me in this same DM that Bay 47 has been their Juniper dock since Oct 14, so it was fine to tell them here. Their message didn't say this pickup is for Juniper, so I asked them to let me know if it's for something else or if the dock has changed. I didn't use the dock notes from Ilse's and Marcus's DMs, since those are private to them.
